statement: Prefer a hosted or software-as-a-service arrangement unless data residency, latency, or integration with on-premise warehouse equipment prohibits it
Suppliers must be on the approved list before contract, which requires a completed security review and a financial standing check
Personal data relating to employees must be stored and processed within the country of employment; customer and trade data may leave it only under an approved transfer agreement
Any system holding confidential or regulated data must support single sign-on, enforce multi-factor authentication, and provide an exportable audit log
Open source components are permitted with a permissive licence; copyleft licences require legal review before use in customer-facing systems
New integrations must go through the message broker rather than direct database connections between applications
The customer master is the only authoritative source of trade account data; no application may maintain its own trade account records
Temperature records evidencing cold chain integrity must be retained and be retrievable for seven years
